title: Symmetry of the binary dot product
statement: For every natural number $n$, the coordinate dot product on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ is symmetric: for all $x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the value at $(x,y)$ equals the value at $(y,x)$.
